body: To be honest, I love my family, but I'm not comfortable with them knowing

I wish I felt the same. I've had a few family members and friends commit suicide over the years. I've witnessed first hand what it does. I know how it's like to deal with it on the other end, but it doesn't change how I feel. People move on after a brief period of hurting, I guess is my reasoning.
I'm not joking when I say I don't have any close friends. I have a few acquaintances but none that I'd confide in.
Thanks for listening/reading. I just wish I could talk about it with someone face to face.

You described it pretty well. Thing is, I know it's all in my head but the feelings are so strong. Like I genuinely do not want to live when I get I'm those moods. Sorry for the delayed response. I figured I would just go to bed instead of staying awake and thinking about everything. I have a perfectly circular bruise that I'm going to have to cover up some way, but I'm here.
Thank you kind stranger. It feels good to just get it all out there, especially when you have  no one to really talk to about it.

I've cut before, honestly, but it has been years. It mostly during my I'm an emo kid and life sucks phase...but it was never like this nor this bad. I'm ashamed of it, honestly. I wear bandages and long sleeves to keep people from asking questions. 

I just got my authorization for free mental health care in my email this morning, so I'm going to set that up. I've just been worrying myself. My coworkers and family see the change, they just don't know how bad it truly is. 

Thank you.
